notes: The launcher checks for updates every time you open it, explains itself when it cannot update, and apps now follow Electron's rules for files and messages.
changes: The launcher now looks for a newer version every time it starts, and at least once a day while it stays open, and tells you with the update card.
Pictures, fonts, sounds, videos and style sheets that an app's own server provides now load the way they do in an Electron app: the launcher answers the page's requests for them itself, with…
Messages between an app's window and its core now carry everything Electron's IPC carries: dates, maps, sets, typed arrays, big integers, errors, undefined and shared or cyclic references.
When a handler fails, the window's promise now rejects with Electron's text: Error invoking remote method '<channel>': <error>.
In an app's core, ipcMain is now a real EventEmitter (once, eventNames, listenerCount, …), its events carry reply, type, processId and frameId as in Electron, and ipcMain.handle reports the same…
In an app's window, window.vmapp.ipcRenderer now has once, addListener, removeAllListeners, eventNames and listenerCount.
A launcher opened straight from Downloads could not update itself and ended with a "read-only volume" error.
